entry.name: Swampert-H4
entry.flavor: Its arms are hard as rock. With one swing, it can break an enormous boulder into pieces.
entry.flavorEs: Swampert puede predecir tormentas al percibir con las aletas los sutiles cambios que producen las olas y las corrientes. Si está a punto de estallar una tormenta, empezará a apilar piedras para resguardarse.

abilities.textEn: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Water attacks.
abilities.textEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Agua cuando le quedan pocos PS.
abilities.detail: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Water-type attack.
abilities.detailEs: Cuando a este Pokémon le queda 1/3 o menos de sus PS, sus movimientos de tipo Agua infligen 1.5× de daño normal.
abilities.detailZh: 当该宝可梦剩余HP为1/3或以下时，其水属性招式造成1.5×的常规伤害。
abilities.detailPt: Quando este Pokémon tem 1/3 ou menos do seu HP restante, seus movimentos do tipo Água infligem 1.5× o dano normal.

abilities.textEn: Prevents Explosion/Mind Blown/Misty Explosion/Self-Destruct/Aftermath while active.
abilities.textEs: Aumenta la humedad del entorno y evita que se puedan utilizar movimientos explosivos, tales como Autodestrucción.
abilities.detail: While this Pokemon is active, Explosion, Mind Blown, Misty Explosion, Self-Destruct, and the Aftermath Ability are prevented from having an effect.
abilities.detailEs: Mientras este Pokémon está en combate, Autodestrucción y Explosión fallarán y Resquicio no surtirá efecto.
abilities.detailZh: 当该宝可梦在场时，自爆和大爆炸会失败，引爆也不会发动。
abilities.detailPt: Enquanto este Pokémon está em batalha, Self-Destruct e Explosion falharão e Aftermath não fará efeito.
